definitions.explanation: A period of calm that occurs near the coast in the evening when the sea breeze dies down. By extension, a peaceful, still evening atmosphere.

examples.english: The time of evening calm has come.

examples.english: The evening calm of the Seto Inland Sea becomes especially hot and humid in summer.

notes: A meteorological and literary term. ⟦{凪|なぎ}→凪：11751_nagi⟧ means a calm or lull in the wind, especially at sea. In coastal areas, the land-sea breeze cycle causes a brief period of stillness around sunset — this is {夕凪|ゆうなぎ}. The counterpart is {朝凪|あさなぎ} (morning calm). In the ⟦{瀬戸内海|せとないかい}→瀬戸内海：30793_setonaikai⟧ (Seto Inland Sea) region, {夕凪|ゆうなぎ} is especially associated with oppressive summer heat because the wind stops completely.
